review.assessment: The change adds till/money.py with MINOR_UNITS mapping and two utility functions, but leaves to_minor broken and unreferenced by any existing code path in this diff.

findings.defect: `to_minor` hardcodes multiplication by 100 instead of using the currency-specific minor unit factor from MINOR_UNITS. For JPY (0 decimal places) a 4300-yen order becomes 430000, exactly matching the reported mismatch.
